instruction: On the Chrome bookmarks bar, create a new folder and call it 'Reading List'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a bookmark folder named 'Reading List' on the bookmarks bar. Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions (is_expected_bookmarks with bookmark_bar_folders_names type). No custom functions needed - reuses official getter/metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome's Bookmarks file from the filesystem and parses JSON structure
Metric logic correctly extracts bookmark_bar folder names and uses subset matching to verify 'Reading List' folder exists
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires (folder named 'Reading List' on bookmarks bar)
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure bookmarks are persisted to disk before verification
Expected value ['Reading List'] semantically matches the instruction requirement
